title: Entitled Woman Acts Tough With Cop, Turns Citation into Arrest
description:
On April 30th, 2022, an officer conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle with no front registration plate. As he approached the driver, he noticed that she was being aggressive and uncooperative. He repeatedly requested her to sit back in her vehicle, but the female didn’t comply and continued to argue with the officer. She also refused to reveal her personal information. She continued to ask the officer to run the VIN number through his records. The woman was showing no signs of complying with the officers. She continued to refuse the officer’s command, completely escalating the situation. The officers tried to help her stand up, but she wasn’t willing to cooperate. She was behaving in a very agitated manner, not allowing the officers to explain the situation to her. The female was charged with resisting arrest, obstructing justice, possession of prohibited substances and no front plate.

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
